```python
class AdminRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "admins"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String, primary_key=True)
    username: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)
    password_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String, nullable=False)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        _UTCDateTime(), default=_utc_now, nullable=False
    )


```

### 块 4：DocumentVersionRecord（第 50—81 行）

**本块作用：**文档版本、处理状态、哈希和错误表，带版本唯一及状态检查。 本块对应源码第 50—81 行。

```python
class DocumentVersionRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "document_versions"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint(
            "document_id", "version", name="uq_document_versions_document_version"
        ),
        CheckConstraint(
            "status IN ('uploaded', 'parsing', 'chunking', 'embedding', "
            "'indexing', 'ready', 'failed')",
            name="ck_document_versions_status",
        ),
    )

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String, primary_key=True)
    document_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("documents.id"), nullable=False
    )
    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False)
    path: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    sha256: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(16), default="uploaded", server_default=text("'uploaded'"), nullable=False
    )
    error: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        _UTCDateTime(), default=_utc_now, nullable=False
    )
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        _UTCDateTime(), default=_utc_now, onupdate=_utc_now, nullable=False
    )


```

### 块 5：TaskRecord（第 82—123 行）

**本块作用：**文档处理任务及尝试次数、负载、租约与错误表。 本块对应源码第 82—123 行。

```python
class TaskRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "tasks"
    __table_args__ = (
        CheckConstraint(
            "status IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed')",
            name="ck_tasks_status",
        ),
    )

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String, primary_key=True)
    document_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("documents.id"), nullable=False
    )
    version_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("document_versions.id"), nullable=True
    )
    kind: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(16), default="queued", server_default=text("'queued'"), nullable=False
    )
    attempts: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        Integer, default=0, server_default=text("0"), nullable=False
    )
    max_attempts: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        Integer, default=3, server_default=text("3"), nullable=False
    )
    payload_json: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(
        JSON, default=dict, server_default=text("'{}'"), nullable=False
    )
    lease_owner: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String, nullable=True)
    lease_expires_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
        _UTCDateTime(), nullable=True
    )
    error: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        _UTCDateTime(), default=_utc_now, nullable=False
    )
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        _UTCDateTime(), default=_utc_now, onupdate=_utc_now, nullable=False
    )


```

```python
class ConversationRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "conversations"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String, primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(200), default="新会话", server_default=text("'新会话'"), nullable=False
    )
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        _UTCDateTime(), default=_utc_now, nullable=False
    )
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        _UTCDateTime(), default=_utc_now, onupdate=_utc_now, nullable=False
    )

    messages: Mapped[list[MessageRecord]] = relationship(
        back_populates="conversation", cascade="all, delete-orphan"
    )


```

### 块 7：MessageRecord（第 143—176 行）

**本块作用：**用户/助手消息表，保存引用 JSON、降级、代次、取消与错误。 本块对应源码第 143—176 行。

```python
class MessageRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "messages"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String, primary_key=True)
    conversation_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("conversations.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False
    )
    role: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=False)
    content: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    citations_json: Mapped[list[dict[str, Any]]] = mapped_column(
        JSON, default=list, server_default=text("'[]'"), nullable=False
    )
    degraded: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(
        Boolean, default=False, server_default=text("0"), nullable=False
    )
    generation_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("index_generations.id"), nullable=True
    )
    cancelled: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(
        Boolean, default=False, server_default=text("0"), nullable=False
    )
    error: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        _UTCDateTime(), default=_utc_now, nullable=False
    )

    conversation: Mapped[ConversationRecord] = relationship(
        back_populates="messages"
    )
    feedback: Mapped[FeedbackRecord | None] = relationship(
        back_populates="message", cascade="all, delete-orphan"
    )


```

### 块 8：ChatRunRecord（第 177—221 行）

**本块作用：**监控运行主表；业务 ID 故意不设外键，事件则级联删除。 本块对应源码第 177—221 行。

```python
class ChatRunRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "chat_runs"
    __table_args__ = (
        CheckConstraint(
            "status IN ('running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')",
            name="ck_chat_runs_status",
        ),
        Index("ix_chat_runs_created_at", "created_at"),
        Index("ix_chat_runs_status_created_at", "status", "created_at"),
        Index("ix_chat_runs_conversation_id", "conversation_id"),
        Index("ix_chat_runs_message_id", "message_id"),
    )

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String, primary_key=True)
    # These identifiers deliberately have no foreign keys: purging business data
    # must not silently remove diagnostic runs, and monitoring purge must not
    # delete conversations or messages.
    conversation_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String, nullable=True)
    message_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String, nullable=True)
    question: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    retrieval_query: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    prompt_messages_json: Mapped[list[dict[str, Any]]] = mapped_column(
        JSON, default=list, server_default=text("'[]'"), nullable=False
    )
    retrieved_text: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    answer: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    generation_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String, nullable=True)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(16), default="running", server_default=text("'running'"), nullable=False
    )
    degraded: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(
        Boolean, default=False, server_default=text("0"), nullable=False
    )
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        _UTCDateTime(), default=_utc_now, nullable=False
    )
    ended_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(_UTCDateTime(), nullable=True)
    duration_ms: Mapped[float | None] = mapped_column(Float, nullable=True)
    error: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)

    events: Mapped[list[ChatRunEventRecord]] = relationship(
        back_populates="run", cascade="all, delete-orphan"
    )


```

### 块 9：ChatRunEventRecord（第 222—243 行）

**本块作用：**监控阶段事件表，外键依赖运行并有查询排序索引。 本块对应源码第 222—243 行。

```python
class ChatRunEventRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "chat_run_events"
    __table_args__ = (
        Index("ix_chat_run_events_run_started", "run_id", "started_at", "id"),
    )

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    run_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("chat_runs.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False
    )
    stage: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=False)
    started_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(_UTCDateTime(), nullable=False)
    ended_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(_UTCDateTime(), nullable=False)
    duration_ms: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Float, nullable=False)
    details_json: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(
        JSON, default=dict, server_default=text("'{}'"), nullable=False
    )
```

### 块 10：FeedbackRecord（第 244—262 行）

**本块作用：**一条消息最多一条 ±1 反馈，可带最多 2000 字评论。 本块对应源码第 244—262 行。

```python
class FeedbackRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "feedback"
    __table_args__ = (
        CheckConstraint("score IN (-1, 1)", name="ck_feedback_score"),
    )

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String, primary_key=True)
    message_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("messages.id", ondelete="CASCADE"),
        unique=True,
        nullable=False,
    )
    score: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False)
    comment: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(2000), nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        _UTCDateTime(), default=_utc_now, nullable=False
    )

    message: Mapped[MessageRecord] = relationship(back_populates="feedback")
```

### 块 4：FakeRAGService.prepare（第 43—79 行）

**本块作用：**测试用 RAG 替身：记录 prepare 收到的 run_id，返回预设的 RAGPreparation，不保存用户消息或选择索引代次。 本块对应源码第 43—79 行。

```python
    async def prepare(self, question, history, generation_id, *, run_id=None):
        self.prepare_calls += 1
        self.histories.append(history)
        self.generation_ids.append(generation_id)
        self.prepare_run_ids.append(run_id)
        if self.prepare_error is not None:
            raise self.prepare_error
        if self.block_preparation:
            if self.prepare_calls == 5:
                self.preparation_started.set()
            await self.release_preparation.wait()
        documents = [
            Document(
                page_content=f"source-{index}",
                metadata={"document_id": f"doc-{index}", "parent_id": f"parent-{index}"},
            )
            for index in range(1, 3)
        ]
        return RAGPreparation(
            original_question=question,
            retrieval_query=question,
            documents=documents,
            citations=[
                Citation(
                    label=f"S{index}",
                    document_id=document.metadata["document_id"],
                    parent_id=document.metadata["parent_id"],
                    text=document.page_content,
                    metadata=dict(document.metadata),
                )
                for index, document in enumerate(documents, start=1)
            ],
            degraded=True,
            generation_id=generation_id,
            insufficient_context=False,
        )

```

### 块 5：FakeRAGService.stream_answer（第 80—97 行）

**本块作用：**资料不足固定拒答，否则流式调用模型、过滤引用，记录成功/失败/取消。 本块对应源码第 80—97 行。

```python
    async def stream_answer(self, prepared, *, run_id=None):
        self.stream_run_ids.append(run_id)
        try:
            if self.chunks:
                yield self.chunks[0]
            if self.stream_error is not None:
                raise self.stream_error
            for chunk in self.chunks[1:]:
                yield chunk
            if self.block_stream:
                self.stream_waiting.set()
                await asyncio.Event().wait()
        finally:
            self.stream_closed.set()
            if self.cleanup_error is not None:
                raise self.cleanup_error


```

### 块 6：make_app（第 98—110 行）

**本块作用：**测试数据/服务工厂，集中构造可重复、相互匹配的被测对象与输入。 本块对应源码第 98—110 行。

```python
def make_app(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("RAG_STATE_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    monkeypatch.setenv("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
    monkeypatch.setenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "correct-password")
    settings = AppSettings(app_env="test", model_provider="fake")
    app = create_app(settings=settings, qdrant_probe=lambda: {"status": "ok"})
    fake = FakeRAGService()
    app.state.rag_service = fake
    if hasattr(app.state, "chat_service"):
        app.state.chat_service.rag_service = fake
    return app, fake


```

### 块 10：assert_one_terminal_run（第 132—143 行）

**本块作用：**确认恰有一个预期终态运行且 JSONL 也恰有一条。 本块对应源码第 132—143 行。

```python
def assert_one_terminal_run(app, status: str, answer: str) -> dict:
    runs = app.state.monitoring_service.list_runs()
    assert len(runs) == 1
    detail = app.state.monitoring_service.get_run(runs[0]["id"])
    assert detail is not None
    assert detail["status"] == status
    assert detail["answer"] == answer
    trace_path = app.state.monitoring_service.trace_path
    assert len(trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()) == 1
    return detail


```

### 块 11：sse_events（第 144—155 行）

**本块作用：**把响应文本按 SSE 空行分块并解析 event 与 JSON data。 本块对应源码第 144—155 行。

```python
def sse_events(response) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    events = []
    for block in response.text.replace("\r\n", "\n").strip().split("\n\n"):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        event = next(line.removeprefix("event: ") for line in lines if line.startswith("event: "))
        data = "\n".join(
            line.removeprefix("data: ") for line in lines if line.startswith("data: ")
        )
        events.append((event, json.loads(data)))
    return events


```

### 块 12：test_sse_order_json_citations_and_persisted_metadata（第 156—206 行）

**本块作用：**验证引用生成或过滤；测试名原文为 test_sse_order_json_citations_and_persisted_metadata。 本块对应源码第 156—206 行。

```python
def test_sse_order_json_citations_and_persisted_metadata(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    app, fake = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    activate_generation(app)
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        csrf = login(client)
        response = chat(client, csrf, {"question": "What is grounded?"})

        assert response.status_code == 200
        assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/event-stream")
        events = sse_events(response)
        assert [event for event, _ in events] == [
            "start",
            "token",
            "token",
            "citations",
            "done",
        ]
        start = events[0][1]
        assert start["conversation_id"]
        assert start["message_id"]
        assert start["generation_id"] == "gen-active"
        assert start["degraded"] is True
        assert events[1][1] == {"content": "grounded "}
        assert events[2][1] == {"content": "answer[S1]"}
        citations = events[3][1]["citations"]
        assert [citation["label"] for citation in citations] == ["S1", "S2"]
        assert [citation["text"] for citation in citations] == ["source-1", "source-2"]
        assert events[4][1]["message_id"] == start["message_id"]
        assert fake.histories == [[]]

        messages = app.state.conversation_service.list_messages(start["conversation_id"])
        assert [(message.role, message.content) for message in messages] == [
            ("user", "What is grounded?"),
            ("assistant", "grounded answer[S1]"),
        ]
        assistant = messages[1]
        assert assistant.id == start["message_id"]
        assert assistant.citations_json == citations
        assert assistant.degraded is True
        assert assistant.generation_id == "gen-active"
        assert assistant.cancelled is False
        assert assistant.error is None

        detail = assert_one_terminal_run(app, "succeeded", "grounded answer[S1]")
        assert detail["message_id"] == start["message_id"]
        assert detail["conversation_id"] == start["conversation_id"]
        assert detail["error"] is None
        assert fake.prepare_run_ids == [detail["id"]]
        assert fake.stream_run_ids == [detail["id"]]


```

### 块 13：test_history_is_last_six_prior_messages_with_langchain_roles（第 207—247 行）

**本块作用：**测试「history is last six prior messages with langchain roles」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 207—247 行。

```python
def test_history_is_last_six_prior_messages_with_langchain_roles(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    app, fake = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    activate_generation(app)
    factory = app.state.conversation_service.session_factory
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        csrf = login(client)
        conversation_id = client.post(
            "/api/sessions", json={}, headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf}
        ).json()["id"]
        base = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
        with factory.begin() as session:
            for index in range(8):
                session.add(
                    MessageRecord(
                        id=f"message-{index}",
                        conversation_id=conversation_id,
                        role="user" if index % 2 == 0 else "assistant",
                        content=f"content-{index}",
                        created_at=base + timedelta(minutes=index),
                    )
                )

        response = chat(
            client,
            csrf,
            {"conversation_id": conversation_id, "question": "follow up"},
        )

        assert response.status_code == 200
        history = fake.histories[0]
        assert [message.content for message in history] == [
            f"content-{index}" for index in range(2, 8)
        ]
        assert all(
            isinstance(message, HumanMessage if index % 2 == 0 else AIMessage)
            for index, message in zip(range(2, 8), history, strict=True)
        )
        assert "follow up" not in [message.content for message in history]
        assert fake.generation_ids == ["gen-active"]


```

### 块 14：test_missing_generation_is_a_sanitized_sse_error（第 248—268 行）

**本块作用：**验证错误信息脱敏；测试名原文为 test_missing_generation_is_a_sanitized_sse_error。 本块对应源码第 248—268 行。

```python
def test_missing_generation_is_a_sanitized_sse_error(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    app, fake = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        csrf = login(client)
        response = chat(client, csrf, {"question": "question"})

        assert response.status_code == 200
        events = sse_events(response)
        assert [event for event, _ in events] == ["error"]
        assert "active" in events[0][1]["message"].lower()
        assert fake.prepare_calls == 0
        conversation = app.state.conversation_service.list()[0]
        messages = app.state.conversation_service.list_messages(conversation.id)
        assert [(message.role, message.content) for message in messages] == [
            ("user", "question")
        ]
        detail = assert_one_terminal_run(app, "failed", "")
        assert detail["message_id"] is None
        assert detail["error"] == events[0][1]["message"]


```

### 块 15：test_provider_failure_is_sanitized_and_partial_is_not_done（第 269—300 行）

**本块作用：**验证错误信息脱敏；测试名原文为 test_provider_failure_is_sanitized_and_partial_is_not_done。 本块对应源码第 269—300 行。

```python
def test_provider_failure_is_sanitized_and_partial_is_not_done(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    app, fake = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    activate_generation(app)
    secret = "provider-secret-token"
    fake.stream_error = RuntimeError(f"provider failed with {secret}")
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        csrf = login(client)
        response = chat(client, csrf, {"question": "question"})

        assert response.status_code == 200
        events = sse_events(response)
        assert [event for event, _ in events] == ["start", "token", "error"]
        assert secret not in response.text
        assert "provider failed with" not in response.text
        conversation_id = events[0][1]["conversation_id"]
        factory = app.state.conversation_service.session_factory
        with factory() as session:
            assistant = session.scalar(
                select(MessageRecord).where(MessageRecord.role == "assistant")
            )
            assert assistant is not None
            assert assistant.content == "grounded "
            assert assistant.cancelled is False
            assert assistant.error == events[-1][1]["message"]
            assert secret not in (assistant.error or "")
        assert app.state.conversation_service.list_messages(conversation_id)
        detail = assert_one_terminal_run(app, "failed", "grounded ")
        assert detail["message_id"] == events[0][1]["message_id"]
        assert detail["error"] == events[-1][1]["message"]
        assert secret not in (detail["error"] or "")


```

### 块 16：test_cancellation_closes_upstream_and_persists_partial_cancelled（第 301—341 行）

**本块作用：**验证提前关闭后的清理；测试名原文为 test_cancellation_closes_upstream_and_persists_partial_cancelled。 本块对应源码第 301—341 行。

```python
def test_cancellation_closes_upstream_and_persists_partial_cancelled(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    async def exercise():
        app, fake = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
        activate_generation(app)
        fake.block_stream = True
        fake.chunks = ["grounded "]
        service = app.state.chat_service
        conversation_id = app.state.conversation_service.create().id
        run_id = app.state.monitoring_service.start_run("question", conversation_id)
        prepared = await service.prepare("question", conversation_id, run_id=run_id)
        events = service.stream(conversation_id, prepared, run_id=run_id)
        start = await anext(events)
        token = await anext(events)
        assert start.event == "start"
        assert token.event == "token"
        pending = asyncio.create_task(anext(events))
        await asyncio.wait_for(fake.stream_waiting.wait(), timeout=1)
        pending.cancel()
        with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await pending
        await asyncio.wait_for(fake.stream_closed.wait(), timeout=1)
        await events.aclose()

        factory = app.state.conversation_service.session_factory
        with factory() as session:
            assistant = session.scalar(
                select(MessageRecord).where(MessageRecord.role == "assistant")
            )
            assert assistant is not None
            assert assistant.content == "grounded "
            assert assistant.cancelled is True
            assert assistant.error is None
        detail = assert_one_terminal_run(app, "cancelled", "grounded ")
        assert detail["message_id"] == start.data["message_id"]
        assert detail["error"] is None

    asyncio.run(exercise())


```

### 块 17：test_close_after_token_finalizes_real_rag_before_terminal_snapshot（第 342—411 行）

**本块作用：**验证提前关闭后的清理；测试名原文为 test_close_after_token_finalizes_real_rag_before_terminal_snapshot。 本块对应源码第 342—411 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_close_after_token_finalizes_real_rag_before_terminal_snapshot(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    app, _ = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    activate_generation(app)

    class ChatModel:
        async def astream(self, messages):
            yield AIMessageChunk(content="partial ")
            yield AIMessageChunk(content="unconsumed")

    monitoring = app.state.monitoring_service
    rag = RAGService(
        ChatModel(),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        object(),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        object(),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        monitoring_service=monitoring,
    )
    service = app.state.chat_service
    service.rag_service = rag
    conversation_id = app.state.conversation_service.create().id
    run_id = monitoring.start_run("question", conversation_id)
    document = Document(
        page_content="source",
        metadata={"document_id": "doc-1", "parent_id": "parent-1"},
    )
    prepared = RAGPreparation(
        original_question="question",
        retrieval_query="question",
        documents=[document],
        citations=[
            Citation(
                label="S1",
                document_id="doc-1",
                parent_id="parent-1",
                text="source",
                metadata=dict(document.metadata),
            )
        ],
        degraded=False,
        generation_id="gen-active",
        insufficient_context=False,
    )
    events = service.stream(conversation_id, prepared, run_id=run_id)
    assert (await anext(events)).event == "start"
    assert (await anext(events)).data == {"content": "partial "}

    await events.aclose()

    detail = assert_one_terminal_run(app, "cancelled", "partial ")
    snapshot = json.loads(
        monitoring.trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[0]
    )
    for traced in (detail, snapshot):
        chat_events = [
            event for event in traced["events"] if event["stage"] == "chat_stream"
        ]
        assert len(chat_events) == 1
        assert chat_events[0]["status"] == "cancelled"
    factory = app.state.conversation_service.session_factory
    with factory() as session:
        assistants = session.scalars(
            select(MessageRecord).where(MessageRecord.role == "assistant")
        ).all()
        assert len(assistants) == 1
        assert assistants[0].content == "partial "
        assert assistants[0].cancelled is True


```

### 块 18：test_api_stream_close_before_first_advance_finishes_cancelled_run（第 412—450 行）

**本块作用：**验证提前关闭后的清理；测试名原文为 test_api_stream_close_before_first_advance_finishes_cancelled_run。 本块对应源码第 412—450 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_api_stream_close_before_first_advance_finishes_cancelled_run(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    app, _ = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    activate_generation(app)
    request = Request(
        {
            "type": "http",
            "asgi": {"version": "3.0"},
            "method": "POST",
            "scheme": "http",
            "path": "/api/chat/stream",
            "raw_path": b"/api/chat/stream",
            "query_string": b"",
            "root_path": "",
            "headers": [],
            "client": ("testclient", 123),
            "server": ("testserver", 80),
            "app": app,
        }
    )
    response = await stream_chat(ChatRequest(question="early close"), request)

    await response.body_iterator.aclose()

    detail = assert_one_terminal_run(app, "cancelled", "")
    assert detail["message_id"] is None
    assert not app.state.chat_semaphore.locked()
    factory = app.state.conversation_service.session_factory
    with factory() as session:
        assert (
            session.scalars(
                select(MessageRecord).where(MessageRecord.role == "assistant")
            ).all()
            == []
        )


```

### 块 19：test_encoding_failure_closes_upstream_releases_slot_and_cancels_run（第 451—493 行）

**本块作用：**验证提前关闭后的清理；测试名原文为 test_encoding_failure_closes_upstream_releases_slot_and_cancels_run。 本块对应源码第 451—493 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_encoding_failure_closes_upstream_releases_slot_and_cancels_run(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    app, fake = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    activate_generation(app)
    semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(1)
    await semaphore.acquire()
    service = app.state.chat_service
    conversation_id = app.state.conversation_service.create().id
    run_id = app.state.monitoring_service.start_run("question", conversation_id)
    prepared = await service.prepare("question", conversation_id, run_id=run_id)
    encoded = _encode_stream(
        service.stream(conversation_id, prepared, run_id=run_id), semaphore.release
    )

    def fail_token_encoding(event):
        if event.event == "token":
            raise RuntimeError("encoding failed")
        return _encode_event(event)

    monkeypatch.setattr("app.api.chat._encode_event", fail_token_encoding)
    assert (await anext(encoded)).startswith(b"event: start")
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="encoding failed"):
        await anext(encoded)

    try:
        assert fake.stream_closed.is_set()
        assert not semaphore.locked()
        detail = assert_one_terminal_run(app, "cancelled", "grounded ")
        assert detail["error"] is None
        factory = app.state.conversation_service.session_factory
        with factory() as session:
            assistant = session.scalar(
                select(MessageRecord).where(MessageRecord.role == "assistant")
            )
            assert assistant is not None
            assert assistant.content == "grounded "
            assert assistant.cancelled is True
    finally:
        await encoded.aclose()


```

### 块 20：test_generator_cleanup_failure_releases_slot_for_next_request（第 494—534 行）

**本块作用：**测试「generator cleanup failure releases slot for next request」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 494—534 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_generator_cleanup_failure_releases_slot_for_next_request(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    app, fake = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    activate_generation(app)
    app.state.chat_semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(1)
    fake.chunks = ["partial"]
    fake.cleanup_error = RuntimeError("upstream cleanup interrupted")
    semaphore = app.state.chat_semaphore
    await semaphore.acquire()
    service = app.state.chat_service
    prepared = await service.prepare("first", None)
    conversation_id = app.state.conversation_service.list()[0].id
    encoded = _encode_stream(
        service.stream(conversation_id, prepared), semaphore.release
    )
    assert (await anext(encoded)).startswith(b"event: start")
    assert (await anext(encoded)).startswith(b"event: token")

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="upstream cleanup interrupted"):
        await encoded.aclose()

    assert not semaphore.locked()
    fake.cleanup_error = None
    transport = httpx.ASGITransport(app=app)
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://test") as client:
        login_response = await client.post(
            "/api/auth/login",
            json={"username": "admin", "password": "correct-password"},
        )
        csrf = login_response.json()["csrf_token"]
        response = await client.post(
            "/api/chat/stream",
            json={"question": "after cleanup"},
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf},
        )
        assert response.status_code == 200
        assert sse_events(response)[-1][0] == "done"


```

### 块 21：test_asgi_disconnect_persists_partial_and_releases_route_slot（第 535—623 行）

**本块作用：**验证客户端断连后的清理；测试名原文为 test_asgi_disconnect_persists_partial_and_releases_route_slot。 本块对应源码第 535—623 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_asgi_disconnect_persists_partial_and_releases_route_slot(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    app, fake = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    activate_generation(app)
    app.state.chat_semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(1)
    fake.chunks = ["partial"]
    fake.block_stream = True
    transport = httpx.ASGITransport(app=app)
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://test") as client:
        login_response = await client.post(
            "/api/auth/login",
            json={"username": "admin", "password": "correct-password"},
        )
        csrf = login_response.json()["csrf_token"]
        cookie = "; ".join(f"{name}={value}" for name, value in client.cookies.items())
        body = json.dumps({"question": "disconnect"}).encode()
        scope = {
            "type": "http",
            "asgi": {"version": "3.0", "spec_version": "2.3"},
            "http_version": "1.1",
            "method": "POST",
            "scheme": "http",
            "path": "/api/chat/stream",
            "raw_path": b"/api/chat/stream",
            "query_string": b"",
            "root_path": "",
            "headers": [
                (b"host", b"testserver"),
                (b"cookie", cookie.encode()),
                (b"x-csrf-token", csrf.encode()),
                (b"content-type", b"application/json"),
                (b"content-length", str(len(body)).encode()),
            ],
            "client": ("testclient", 123),
            "server": ("testserver", 80),
        }
        token_sent = asyncio.Event()
        request_sent = False
        sent_messages = []

        async def receive():
            nonlocal request_sent
            if not request_sent:
                request_sent = True
                return {"type": "http.request", "body": body, "more_body": False}
            await asyncio.wait_for(token_sent.wait(), timeout=1)
            return {"type": "http.disconnect"}

        async def send(message):
            sent_messages.append(message)
            if message["type"] == "http.response.body" and b"event: token" in message.get(
                "body", b""
            ):
                token_sent.set()

        await asyncio.wait_for(app(scope, receive, send), timeout=2)
        await asyncio.wait_for(fake.stream_closed.wait(), timeout=1)

        factory = app.state.conversation_service.session_factory
        with factory() as session:
            assistant = session.scalar(
                select(MessageRecord).where(MessageRecord.role == "assistant")
            )
            assert assistant is not None
            assert assistant.content == "partial"
            assert assistant.cancelled is True
            assert assistant.error is None
        assert not app.state.chat_semaphore.locked()
        detail = assert_one_terminal_run(app, "cancelled", "partial")
        assert detail["message_id"] == assistant.id
        assert detail["error"] is None
        assert any(
            message["type"] == "http.response.body"
            and b"event: token" in message.get("body", b"")
            for message in sent_messages
        )

        fake.block_stream = False
        response = await client.post(
            "/api/chat/stream",
            json={"question": "after disconnect"},
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf},
        )
        assert response.status_code == 200
        assert sse_events(response)[-1][0] == "done"


```

### 块 22：test_sixth_concurrent_chat_gets_immediate_429（第 624—657 行）

**本块作用：**验证聊天并发上限；测试名原文为 test_sixth_concurrent_chat_gets_immediate_429。 本块对应源码第 624—657 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_sixth_concurrent_chat_gets_immediate_429(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    app, fake = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    activate_generation(app)
    fake.block_preparation = True
    transport = httpx.ASGITransport(app=app)
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://test") as client:
        response = await client.post(
            "/api/auth/login",
            json={"username": "admin", "password": "correct-password"},
        )
        csrf = response.json()["csrf_token"]
        headers = {"X-CSRF-Token": csrf}
        requests = [
            asyncio.create_task(
                client.post(
                    "/api/chat/stream", json={"question": f"question-{index}"}, headers=headers
                )
            )
            for index in range(5)
        ]
        await asyncio.wait_for(fake.preparation_started.wait(), timeout=2)

        sixth = await client.post(
            "/api/chat/stream", json={"question": "sixth"}, headers=headers
        )
        assert sixth.status_code == 429
        assert fake.prepare_calls == 5

        fake.release_preparation.set()
        responses = await asyncio.gather(*requests)
        assert [response.status_code for response in responses] == [200] * 5


```

### 块 23：test_monitoring_failures_never_change_sse_or_partial_answers（第 658—690 行）

**本块作用：**测试「monitoring failures never change sse or partial answers」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 658—690 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.parametrize("provider_failure", [False, True])
def test_monitoring_failures_never_change_sse_or_partial_answers(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, provider_failure: bool
):
    app, fake = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    activate_generation(app)
    if provider_failure:
        fake.stream_error = RuntimeError("provider-secret")

    def fail_monitoring(*args, **kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError("monitoring unavailable")

    monkeypatch.setattr(app.state.monitoring_service, "set_message_id", fail_monitoring)
    monkeypatch.setattr(app.state.monitoring_service, "finish_run", fail_monitoring)
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        response = chat(client, login(client), {"question": "question"})

    assert response.status_code == 200
    events = sse_events(response)
    if provider_failure:
        assert [event for event, _ in events] == ["start", "token", "error"]
        assert "provider-secret" not in response.text
    else:
        assert [event for event, _ in events] == [
            "start",
            "token",
            "token",
            "citations",
            "done",
        ]
        assert events[-2][1]["citations"][0]["text"] == "source-1"


```

### 块 24：test_monitoring_start_failure_does_not_change_chat（第 691—711 行）

**本块作用：**测试「monitoring start failure does not change chat」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 691—711 行。

```python
def test_monitoring_start_failure_does_not_change_chat(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    app, _ = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    activate_generation(app)

    def fail_start(*args, **kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError("monitoring unavailable")

    monkeypatch.setattr(app.state.monitoring_service, "start_run", fail_start)
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        response = chat(client, login(client), {"question": "question"})

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert [event for event, _ in sse_events(response)] == [
        "start",
        "token",
        "token",
        "citations",
        "done",
    ]


```

### 块 25：test_feedback_is_local_upsert_with_validation（第 712—790 行）

**本块作用：**测试「feedback is local upsert with validation」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 712—790 行。

```python
def test_feedback_is_local_upsert_with_validation(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    app, _ = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    factory = app.state.conversation_service.session_factory
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        csrf = login(client)
        conversation_id = client.post(
            "/api/sessions", json={}, headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf}
        ).json()["id"]
        with factory.begin() as session:
            session.add(
                MessageRecord(
                    id="assistant-message",
                    conversation_id=conversation_id,
                    role="assistant",
                    content="answer",
                )
            )

        maximum_comment = "x" * 2000
        first = client.post(
            "/api/feedback",
            json={
                "message_id": "assistant-message",
                "score": 1,
                "comment": maximum_comment,
            },
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf},
        )
        assert first.status_code == 200
        assert first.json()["score"] == 1
        assert first.json()["comment"] == maximum_comment
        assert "run_id" not in first.json()
        assert "langsmith" not in first.text.lower()

        second = client.post(
            "/api/feedback",
            json={"message_id": "assistant-message", "score": -1, "comment": "updated"},
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf},
        )
        assert second.status_code == 200
        assert second.json()["id"] == first.json()["id"]
        assert second.json()["score"] == -1
        assert second.json()["comment"] == "updated"
        with factory() as session:
            assert session.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(FeedbackRecord)) == 1
            feedback = session.scalar(select(FeedbackRecord))
            assert feedback is not None
            assert not hasattr(feedback, "run_id")

        assert (
            client.post(
                "/api/feedback",
                json={"message_id": "missing", "score": 1},
                headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf},
            ).status_code
            == 404
        )
        assert (
            client.post(
                "/api/feedback",
                json={"message_id": "assistant-message", "score": 0},
                headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf},
            ).status_code
            == 422
        )
        assert (
            client.post(
                "/api/feedback",
                json={
                    "message_id": "assistant-message",
                    "score": 1,
                    "comment": "x" * 2001,
                },
                headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf},
            ).status_code
            == 422
        )


```

### 块 26：test_chat_and_feedback_require_authentication（第 791—797 行）

**本块作用：**测试「chat and feedback require authentication」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 791—797 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", ["/api/chat/stream", "/api/feedback"])
def test_chat_and_feedback_require_authentication(tmp_path, monkeypatch, path):
    app, _ = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        assert client.post(path, json={}).status_code == 401


```

### 块 27：test_chat_and_feedback_require_csrf（第 798—803 行）

**本块作用：**测试「chat and feedback require csrf」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 798—803 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", ["/api/chat/stream", "/api/feedback"])
def test_chat_and_feedback_require_csrf(tmp_path, monkeypatch, path):
    app, _ = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        login(client)
        assert client.post(path, json={}).status_code == 403
```

## `tests/integration/test_monitoring_api.py`

```python
    "hours",

}

    "dashscope_api_key",

}
```

### 块 2：make_app（第 56—63 行）

**本块作用：**测试数据/服务工厂，集中构造可重复、相互匹配的被测对象与输入。 本块对应源码第 56—63 行。

```python
def make_app(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("RAG_STATE_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    monkeypatch.setenv("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
    monkeypatch.setenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "correct-password")
    settings = AppSettings(app_env="test", model_provider="fake")
    return create_app(settings=settings, qdrant_probe=lambda: {"status": "ok"})


```

### 块 3：client（第 64—70 行）

**本块作用：**pytest 夹具：为每个测试提供独立对象，避免测试间共享可变状态。 本块对应源码第 64—70 行。

```python
@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
    app = make_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    with TestClient(app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


```

### 块 5：seed_runs（第 79—109 行）

**本块作用：**向真实监控服务写入一个成功和一个失败运行。 本块对应源码第 79—109 行。

```python
def seed_runs(client: TestClient) -> tuple[str, str]:
    service = client.app.state.monitoring_service
    succeeded_id = service.start_run("original question", "conversation-1")
    service.set_message_id(succeeded_id, "message-1")
    started_at = datetime(2026, 11, 20, 10, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
    service.record_event(
        succeeded_id,
        "dense",
        "succeeded",
        started_at,
        12.5,
        {"candidates": 2},
    )
    service.update_preparation(
        succeeded_id,
        SimpleNamespace(
            retrieval_query="rewritten question",
            documents=[Document(page_content="retrieved text")],
            degraded=False,
            generation_id="generation-1",
        ),
        [SystemMessage(content="system prompt"), HumanMessage(content="question")],
    )
    service.finish_run(succeeded_id, "succeeded", "final answer")

    failed_id = service.start_run("failed question", "conversation-2")
    service.set_message_id(failed_id, "message-2")
    service.finish_run(failed_id, "failed", "partial answer", "sanitized error")
    return succeeded_id, failed_id


```

### 块 6：assert_no_credential_fields（第 110—119 行）

**本块作用：**递归检查响应字典/列表不包含敏感字段名。 本块对应源码第 110—119 行。

```python
def assert_no_credential_fields(value: Any) -> None:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        assert _CREDENTIAL_FIELDS.isdisjoint(value)
        for nested in value.values():
            assert_no_credential_fields(nested)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for nested in value:
            assert_no_credential_fields(nested)


```

### 块 7：test_monitoring_routes_require_authentication（第 120—134 行）

**本块作用：**测试「monitoring routes require authentication」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 120—134 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "path",
    [
        "/api/monitoring/summary?hours=24",
        "/api/monitoring/runs?limit=50&status=&query=",
        "/api/monitoring/runs/run-1",
    ],
)
def test_monitoring_routes_require_authentication(client: TestClient, path: str):
    response = client.get(path)

    assert response.status_code == 401
    assert response.json() == {"detail": "Authentication required"}


```

### 块 8：test_authenticated_summary_list_filters_and_detail_without_csrf（第 135—211 行）

**本块作用：**验证汇总统计；测试名原文为 test_authenticated_summary_list_filters_and_detail_without_csrf。 本块对应源码第 135—211 行。

```python
def test_authenticated_summary_list_filters_and_detail_without_csrf(
    client: TestClient,
):
    succeeded_id, failed_id = seed_runs(client)
    factory = client.app.state.monitoring_service.session_factory
    with factory.begin() as session:
        session.add(ConversationRecord(id="feedback-conversation", title="Feedback"))
        session.add(
            MessageRecord(
                id="feedback-message",
                conversation_id="feedback-conversation",
                role="assistant",
                content="answer",
            )
        )
        session.add(
            FeedbackRecord(id="feedback-1", message_id="feedback-message", score=1)
        )
    login(client)

    # No X-CSRF-Token header is needed for any read-only monitoring request.
    summary_response = client.get("/api/monitoring/summary?hours=24")
    assert summary_response.status_code == 200
    summary = summary_response.json()
    assert set(summary) == _SUMMARY_FIELDS
    assert summary["hours"] == 24
    assert summary["total"] == 2
    assert summary["succeeded"] == 1
    assert summary["failed"] == 1
    assert summary["running"] == summary["cancelled"] == summary["degraded"] == 0
    assert summary["average_duration_ms"] >= 0
    assert summary["p95_duration_ms"] >= 0
    assert not {"likes", "dislikes", "like_count", "dislike_count"} & set(summary)

    listed_response = client.get("/api/monitoring/runs?limit=50&status=&query=")
    assert listed_response.status_code == 200
    listed = listed_response.json()
    assert {run["id"] for run in listed} == {succeeded_id, failed_id}
    assert all(set(run) == _RUN_FIELDS for run in listed)

    failed = client.get("/api/monitoring/runs?status=failed").json()
    assert [run["id"] for run in failed] == [failed_id]
    for query in (succeeded_id, "conversation-1", "message-1"):
        filtered = client.get(f"/api/monitoring/runs?query={query}")
        assert filtered.status_code == 200
        assert [run["id"] for run in filtered.json()] == [succeeded_id]

    detail_response = client.get(f"/api/monitoring/runs/{succeeded_id}")
    assert detail_response.status_code == 200
    detail = detail_response.json()
    assert set(detail) == _RUN_FIELDS | {
        "retrieval_query",
        "prompt_messages",
        "retrieved_text",
        "answer",
        "generation_id",
        "error",
        "events",
    }
    assert detail["question"] == "original question"
    assert detail["retrieval_query"] == "rewritten question"
    assert detail["retrieved_text"] == "retrieved text"
    assert detail["prompt_messages"] == [
        {"type": "system", "content": "system prompt"},
        {"type": "human", "content": "question"},
    ]
    assert detail["answer"] == "final answer"
    assert [event["stage"] for event in detail["events"]] == ["dense", "terminal"]
    assert detail["events"][0]["details"] == {"candidates": 2}

    for payload in (summary, listed, detail):
        assert_no_credential_fields(payload)
        serialized = str(payload).lower()
        assert "like_count" not in serialized
        assert "dislike_count" not in serialized


```

### 块 15：test_monitoring_routes_return_sanitized_503_on_storage_failure（第 270—308 行）

**本块作用：**验证错误信息脱敏；测试名原文为 test_monitoring_routes_return_sanitized_503_on_storage_failure。 本块对应源码第 270—308 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "path",
    [
        "/api/monitoring/summary?hours=24",
        "/api/monitoring/runs?limit=50&status=&query=",
        "/api/monitoring/runs/existing-run",
    ],
)
def test_monitoring_routes_return_sanitized_503_on_storage_failure(
    client: TestClient, path: str
):
    succeeded_id, _failed_id = seed_runs(client)
    detail_path = f"/api/monitoring/runs/{succeeded_id}"
    if path.endswith("existing-run"):
        path = detail_path
    login(client)

    class BrokenFactory:
        def __call__(self):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "SELECT * FROM private_table; password=API_DB_SECRET; "
                r"C:\private\API_DB_PATH\index.sqlite3"
            )

    client.app.state.monitoring_service.session_factory = BrokenFactory()

    response = client.get(path)

    assert response.status_code == 503
    assert response.json() == {"detail": "Monitoring storage unavailable"}
    for sentinel in (
        "SELECT",
        "private_table",
        "API_DB_SECRET",
        "API_DB_PATH",
        "password=",
        "index.sqlite3",
    ):
        assert sentinel not in response.text
```

### 块 2：test_monitoring_tables_are_added_incrementally_and_idempotently（第 13—57 行）

**本块作用：**验证重复执行不会误删或重复追加；测试名原文为 test_monitoring_tables_are_added_incrementally_and_idempotently。 本块对应源码第 13—57 行。

```python
def test_monitoring_tables_are_added_incrementally_and_idempotently(tmp_path: Path):
    path = tmp_path / "legacy.sqlite3"
    with sqlite3.connect(path) as connection:
        connection.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE documents ("
            "id VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY, "
            "content_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, "
            "metadata_json JSON NOT NULL)"
        )
        connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO documents (id, content_hash, metadata_json) "
            "VALUES ('legacy-doc', 'legacy-hash', '{\"legacy\": true}')"
        )
        original_root_page = connection.execute(
            "SELECT rootpage FROM sqlite_master WHERE name = 'documents'"
        ).fetchone()[0]

    factory = create_session_factory(path)
    ensure_web_schema(factory)
    ensure_web_schema(factory)

    inspector = inspect(factory.kw["bind"])
    assert {"chat_runs", "chat_run_events"} <= set(inspector.get_table_names())
    assert {index["name"] for index in inspector.get_indexes("chat_runs")} >= {
        "ix_chat_runs_created_at",
        "ix_chat_runs_status_created_at",
    }
    assert {index["name"] for index in inspector.get_indexes("chat_run_events")} >= {
        "ix_chat_run_events_run_started",
    }
    with factory() as session:
        assert (
            session.execute(
                text("SELECT content_hash FROM documents WHERE id = 'legacy-doc'")
            ).scalar_one()
            == "legacy-hash"
        )
        assert (
            session.execute(
                text("SELECT rootpage FROM sqlite_master WHERE name = 'documents'")
            ).scalar_one()
            == original_root_page
        )


```

### 块 3：test_chat_run_events_cascade_and_enforce_foreign_keys（第 58—109 行）

**本块作用：**测试「chat run events cascade and enforce foreign keys」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 58—109 行。

```python
def test_chat_run_events_cascade_and_enforce_foreign_keys(tmp_path: Path):
    factory = create_session_factory(tmp_path / "index.sqlite3")
    started_at = datetime(2026, 11, 20, 8, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
    with factory() as session:
        session.add(
            ChatRunRecord(
                id="run-1",
                conversation_id="conversation-1",
                question="question",
                status="running",
                created_at=started_at,
            )
        )
        session.add(
            ChatRunEventRecord(
                run_id="run-1",
                stage="dense",
                status="succeeded",
                started_at=started_at,
                ended_at=started_at + timedelta(milliseconds=12),
                duration_ms=12,
                details_json={"count": 3},
            )
        )
        session.commit()
        event_id = session.scalars(
            text("SELECT id FROM chat_run_events WHERE run_id = 'run-1'")
        ).one_or_none()
        assert event_id is not None

        stored = session.get(ChatRunRecord, "run-1")
        assert stored.created_at.utcoffset() == timedelta(0)
        assert stored.events[0].details_json == {"count": 3}
        session.delete(stored)
        session.commit()
        assert session.get(ChatRunEventRecord, event_id) is None

        session.add(
            ChatRunEventRecord(
                run_id="missing",
                stage="dense",
                status="succeeded",
                started_at=started_at,
                ended_at=started_at,
                duration_ms=0,
                details_json={},
            )
        )
        with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
            session.commit()


```

### 块 4：test_chat_run_accepts_terminal_and_running_statuses（第 110—118 行）

**本块作用：**测试「chat run accepts terminal and running statuses」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 110—118 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", ["running", "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"])
def test_chat_run_accepts_terminal_and_running_statuses(tmp_path: Path, status: str):
    factory = create_session_factory(tmp_path / f"{status}.sqlite3")
    with factory() as session:
        session.add(ChatRunRecord(id=f"run-{status}", question="q", status=status))
        session.commit()
        assert session.get(ChatRunRecord, f"run-{status}").status == status


```

### 块 2：test_monitoring_purge_removes_only_old_traces_and_is_idempotent（第 30—115 行）

**本块作用：**验证重复执行不会误删或重复追加；测试名原文为 test_monitoring_purge_removes_only_old_traces_and_is_idempotent。 本块对应源码第 30—115 行。

```python
def test_monitoring_purge_removes_only_old_traces_and_is_idempotent(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
):
    state_root = tmp_path / "state"
    state_root.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.setenv("RAG_STATE_DIR", str(state_root))
    service = MonitoringService(
        create_session_factory(state_root / "index.sqlite3"), state_root
    )
    factory = service.session_factory
    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=30)
    old_id = service.start_run("old question", "conversation-1")
    new_id = service.start_run("new question", "conversation-1")
    with factory.begin() as session:
        old_run = session.get(ChatRunRecord, old_id)
        old_run.created_at = cutoff - timedelta(minutes=1)
        for run_id, created_at in (
            (old_id, old_run.created_at),
            (new_id, cutoff + timedelta(minutes=1)),
        ):
            session.add(
                ChatRunEventRecord(
                    run_id=run_id,
                    stage="terminal",
                    status="succeeded",
                    started_at=created_at,
                    ended_at=created_at,
                    duration_ms=1,
                    details_json={},
                )
            )
        session.add(ConversationRecord(id="conversation-1", title="Keep me"))
        session.add(
            MessageRecord(
                id="message-1",
                conversation_id="conversation-1",
                role="assistant",
                content="Keep this answer",
            )
        )
        session.add(
            FeedbackRecord(
                id="feedback-1",
                message_id="message-1",
                score=-1,
                comment="Keep this feedback",
            )
        )
    service.finish_run(old_id, "succeeded", "old answer")
    service.finish_run(new_id, "succeeded", "new answer")

    result = runner.invoke(cli_app, ["monitoring-purge", "--days", "30"])

    assert result.exit_code == 0, result.output
    assert "Deleted monitoring runs: 1" in result.output
    assert "Cutoff:" in result.output
    assert service.get_run(old_id) is None
    assert service.get_run(new_id) is not None
    with factory() as session:
        remaining_events = session.scalars(select(ChatRunEventRecord)).all()
        assert [event.run_id for event in remaining_events] == [new_id, new_id]
        assert all(event.stage == "terminal" for event in remaining_events)
        assert session.get(ConversationRecord, "conversation-1") is not None
        assert session.get(MessageRecord, "message-1") is not None
        assert session.get(FeedbackRecord, "feedback-1") is not None
    remaining_snapshots = [
        json.loads(line)
        for line in service.trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    ]
    assert [snapshot["id"] for snapshot in remaining_snapshots] == [new_id]

    second_result = runner.invoke(cli_app, ["monitoring-purge", "--days", "30"])

    assert second_result.exit_code == 0, second_result.output
    assert "Deleted monitoring runs: 0" in second_result.output
    assert service.get_run(new_id) is not None
    assert [
        json.loads(line)
        for line in service.trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    ] == remaining_snapshots
    with factory() as session:
        assert session.get(ConversationRecord, "conversation-1") is not None
        assert session.get(MessageRecord, "message-1") is not None
        assert session.get(FeedbackRecord, "feedback-1") is not None


```

### 块 3：test_monitoring_retention_is_typed_and_loaded_from_yaml（第 116—128 行）

**本块作用：**验证保留期配置与清理；测试名原文为 test_monitoring_retention_is_typed_and_loaded_from_yaml。 本块对应源码第 116—128 行。

```python
def test_monitoring_retention_is_typed_and_loaded_from_yaml(tmp_path: Path):
    config = tmp_path / "config.yaml"
    config.write_text("monitoring:\n  retention_days: 45\n", encoding="utf-8")

    settings = load_settings(config)

    assert settings.monitoring == MonitoringSettings(retention_days=45)
    assert AppSettings().monitoring.retention_days == 30
    config.write_text("monitoring:\n  retention_days: 0\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError, match="retention_days"):
        load_settings(config)


```

### 块 5：test_monitoring_purge_database_failure_is_nonzero_and_sanitized（第 136—174 行）

**本块作用：**验证错误信息脱敏；测试名原文为 test_monitoring_purge_database_failure_is_nonzero_and_sanitized。 本块对应源码第 136—174 行。

```python
def test_monitoring_purge_database_failure_is_nonzero_and_sanitized(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
):
    monkeypatch.setenv("RAG_STATE_DIR", str(tmp_path / "state"))

    class BrokenFactory:
        def __call__(self):
            raise self.error()

        def begin(self):
            raise self.error()

        @staticmethod
        def error():
            return DatabaseError(
                "DELETE FROM private_table WHERE token = 'CLI_DB_SECRET'",
                None,
                Exception(r"C:\private\CLI_DB_PATH\index.sqlite3"),
            )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "app.cli.create_session_factory", lambda _path: BrokenFactory()
    )

    result = runner.invoke(cli_app, ["monitoring-purge", "--days", "30"])

    assert result.exit_code == 1
    assert "Database operation failed" in result.output
    assert "Deleted monitoring runs" not in result.output
    for sentinel in (
        "DELETE FROM",
        "private_table",
        "CLI_DB_SECRET",
        "CLI_DB_PATH",
        "index.sqlite3",
    ):
        assert sentinel not in result.output


```

### 块 6：test_monitoring_purge_jsonl_failure_is_nonzero_and_sanitized（第 175—193 行）

**本块作用：**验证错误信息脱敏；测试名原文为 test_monitoring_purge_jsonl_failure_is_nonzero_and_sanitized。 本块对应源码第 175—193 行。

```python
def test_monitoring_purge_jsonl_failure_is_nonzero_and_sanitized(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
):
    monkeypatch.setenv("RAG_STATE_DIR", str(tmp_path / "state"))

    def fail_compaction(_self, _run_ids):
        raise OSError(
            r"C:\private\CLI_JSONL_PATH\chat-trace.jsonl password=CLI_JSONL_SECRET"
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(MonitoringService, "_purge_jsonl", fail_compaction)

    result = runner.invoke(cli_app, ["monitoring-purge", "--days", "30"])

    assert result.exit_code == 1
    assert "Local file or network operation failed" in result.output
    assert "Deleted monitoring runs" not in result.output
    for sentinel in ("CLI_JSONL_PATH", "CLI_JSONL_SECRET", "password=", "chat-trace"):
        assert sentinel not in result.output
```

### 块 4：add_run（第 36—63 行）

**本块作用：**测试数据/服务工厂，集中构造可重复、相互匹配的被测对象与输入。 本块对应源码第 36—63 行。

```python
def add_run(
    tmp_path: Path,
    run_id: str,
    *,
    status: str = "succeeded",
    created_at: datetime | None = None,
    duration_ms: float | None = 100,
    conversation_id: str | None = None,
    message_id: str | None = None,
    degraded: bool = False,
) -> None:
    factory = create_session_factory(tmp_path / "index.sqlite3")
    with factory.begin() as session:
        session.add(
            ChatRunRecord(
                id=run_id,
                conversation_id=conversation_id,
                message_id=message_id,
                question=f"question for {run_id}",
                status=status,
                created_at=created_at or datetime.now(UTC),
                ended_at=created_at or datetime.now(UTC),
                duration_ms=duration_ms,
                degraded=degraded,
            )
        )


```

### 块 5：test_terminal_run_has_preparation_ordered_events_and_one_jsonl_snapshot（第 64—135 行）

**本块作用：**验证 JSONL 快照或清理；测试名原文为 test_terminal_run_has_preparation_ordered_events_and_one_jsonl_snapshot。 本块对应源码第 64—135 行。

```python
def test_terminal_run_has_preparation_ordered_events_and_one_jsonl_snapshot(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
):
    ticks = iter([1000.0, 1000.25])
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.monitoring.service.perf_counter", lambda: next(ticks))
    service = make_service(tmp_path)
    run_id = service.start_run("original question", "conversation-1")
    service.set_message_id(run_id, "message-1")
    started_at = datetime(2026, 11, 20, 10, 0, tzinfo=UTC)

    service.record_event(
        run_id,
        "dense",
        "succeeded",
        started_at,
        12.5,
        {"candidates": 3},
    )
    service.record_event(
        run_id, "rerank", "succeeded", started_at + timedelta(seconds=1), 20
    )
    service.update_preparation(
        run_id,
        make_preparation(),
        [SystemMessage(content="system prompt"), HumanMessage(content="question")],
    )
    service.finish_run(run_id, "succeeded", "final answer")

    detail = service.get_run(run_id)
    assert detail is not None
    assert detail["question"] == "original question"
    assert detail["message_id"] == "message-1"
    assert [run["id"] for run in service.list_runs(query="message-1")] == [run_id]
    assert detail["retrieval_query"] == "rewritten question"
    assert detail["retrieved_text"] == ("first retrieved text\n\nsecond retrieved text")
    assert detail["prompt_messages"] == [
        {"type": "system", "content": "system prompt"},
        {"type": "human", "content": "question"},
    ]
    assert detail["generation_id"] == "generation-1"
    assert detail["degraded"] is True
    assert detail["answer"] == "final answer"
    assert detail["status"] == "succeeded"
    assert detail["duration_ms"] == pytest.approx(250)
    assert detail["created_at"].tzinfo is not None
    assert detail["ended_at"].tzinfo is not None
    assert [event["stage"] for event in detail["events"]] == [
        "dense",
        "rerank",
        "terminal",
    ]
    assert detail["events"][0]["details"] == {"candidates": 3}
    assert detail["events"][0]["ended_at"] == started_at + timedelta(milliseconds=12.5)

    trace_path = tmp_path / "state" / "monitoring" / "chat-trace.jsonl"
    snapshots = [json.loads(line) for line in trace_path.read_text().splitlines()]
    assert len(snapshots) == 1
    assert snapshots[0]["id"] == run_id
    assert snapshots[0]["status"] == "succeeded"
    assert [event["stage"] for event in snapshots[0]["events"]] == [
        "dense",
        "rerank",
        "terminal",
    ]
    if os.name == "posix":
        assert trace_path.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o600

    service.finish_run(run_id, "failed", "replacement", "do not replace")
    assert service.get_run(run_id)["answer"] == "final answer"
    assert len(trace_path.read_text().splitlines()) == 1


```

### 块 6：test_summary_counts_statuses_and_computes_average_and_nearest_rank_p95（第 136—172 行）

**本块作用：**验证汇总统计；测试名原文为 test_summary_counts_statuses_and_computes_average_and_nearest_rank_p95。 本块对应源码第 136—172 行。

```python
def test_summary_counts_statuses_and_computes_average_and_nearest_rank_p95(
    tmp_path: Path,
):
    service = make_service(tmp_path)
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    for index, duration in enumerate([100, 200, 300, 400]):
        add_run(
            tmp_path,
            f"run-{index}",
            created_at=now - timedelta(minutes=index),
            duration_ms=duration,
            degraded=index == 0,
        )
    add_run(tmp_path, "failed", status="failed", duration_ms=None)
    add_run(tmp_path, "cancelled", status="cancelled", duration_ms=None)
    add_run(tmp_path, "running", status="running", duration_ms=None)
    add_run(
        tmp_path,
        "old",
        created_at=now - timedelta(hours=25),
        duration_ms=10_000,
    )

    summary = service.summary(24)
    assert summary == {
        "hours": 24,
        "total": 7,
        "running": 1,
        "succeeded": 4,
        "failed": 1,
        "cancelled": 1,
        "degraded": 1,
        "average_duration_ms": 250,
        "p95_duration_ms": 400,
    }


```

### 块 7：test_list_filters_by_status_and_ids_and_get_run_contains_details（第 173—223 行）

**本块作用：**验证列表与筛选；测试名原文为 test_list_filters_by_status_and_ids_and_get_run_contains_details。 本块对应源码第 173—223 行。

```python
def test_list_filters_by_status_and_ids_and_get_run_contains_details(
    tmp_path: Path,
):
    service = make_service(tmp_path)
    base = datetime.now(UTC)
    add_run(
        tmp_path,
        "request-1",
        created_at=base,
        conversation_id="conversation-1",
        message_id="message-1",
    )
    add_run(
        tmp_path,
        "request-2",
        status="failed",
        created_at=base + timedelta(seconds=1),
        conversation_id="conversation-2",
        message_id="message-2",
    )
    factory = create_session_factory(tmp_path / "index.sqlite3")
    with factory.begin() as session:
        session.add(
            ChatRunEventRecord(
                run_id="request-1",
                stage="terminal",
                status="succeeded",
                started_at=base,
                ended_at=base,
                duration_ms=0,
                details_json={"local": True},
            )
        )

    assert [run["id"] for run in service.list_runs(50, None, None)] == [
        "request-2",
        "request-1",
    ]
    assert [run["id"] for run in service.list_runs(50, "failed", None)] == ["request-2"]
    for query in ("request-1", "conversation-1", "message-1"):
        assert [run["id"] for run in service.list_runs(50, None, query)] == [
            "request-1"
        ]
    assert service.list_runs(50, None, "not-found") == []
    assert len(service.list_runs(1, None, None)) == 1
    assert service.get_run("request-1")["events"][0]["details"] == {"local": True}
    assert service.get_run("missing") is None
    for invalid_limit in (0, -1, 101, "50", None):
        assert service.list_runs(invalid_limit, None, None) == []


```

### 块 8：test_invalid_public_arguments_fail_open（第 224—244 行）

**本块作用：**测试「invalid public arguments fail open」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 224—244 行。

```python
def test_invalid_public_arguments_fail_open(tmp_path: Path):
    service = make_service(tmp_path)
    run_id = service.start_run("question", "1")

    for invalid_status in ("running", "unknown", None, []):
        service.finish_run(run_id, invalid_status, "must not persist")
    assert service.get_run(run_id)["status"] == "running"
    assert service.get_run(run_id)["answer"] is None

    for invalid_hours in (0, -1, 8761, "24", None):
        summary = service.summary(invalid_hours)
        assert summary["total"] == 0
        assert summary["average_duration_ms"] == 0
        assert summary["p95_duration_ms"] == 0

    for invalid_status in ("unknown", 1, []):
        assert service.list_runs(50, invalid_status, None) == []
    for invalid_query in (1, object(), ["run-id"]):
        assert service.list_runs(50, None, invalid_query) == []


```

### 块 9：test_failed_terminal_sql_preserves_start_clock_for_retry（第 245—277 行）

**本块作用：**测试「failed terminal sql preserves start clock for retry」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 245—277 行。

```python
def test_failed_terminal_sql_preserves_start_clock_for_retry(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
):
    ticks = iter([100.0, 100.1, 100.9])
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.monitoring.service.perf_counter", lambda: next(ticks))
    service = make_service(tmp_path)
    run_id = service.start_run("question", "conversation-1")
    working_factory = service.session_factory

    class FailOnceFactory:
        def __init__(self):
            self.should_fail = True

        def begin(self):
            if self.should_fail:
                self.should_fail = False
                raise RuntimeError("transient SQL failure")
            return working_factory.begin()

        def __call__(self):
            return working_factory()

    service.session_factory = FailOnceFactory()
    service.finish_run(run_id, "succeeded", "first attempt")
    assert service.get_run(run_id)["status"] == "running"

    service.finish_run(run_id, "succeeded", "retry answer")
    detail = service.get_run(run_id)
    assert detail["status"] == "succeeded"
    assert detail["answer"] == "retry answer"
    assert detail["duration_ms"] == pytest.approx(900)


```

### 块 10：test_sql_failures_are_fail_open_and_do_not_log_secrets_or_tracebacks（第 278—304 行）

**本块作用：**测试「sql failures are fail open and do not log secrets or tracebacks」描述的行为；准备输入、执行被测操作，再用断言固定可观察结果。 本块对应源码第 278—304 行。

```python
def test_sql_failures_are_fail_open_and_do_not_log_secrets_or_tracebacks(
    tmp_path: Path, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
):
    class BrokenFactory:
        def __call__(self):
            raise RuntimeError("password=do-not-log")

        def begin(self):
            raise RuntimeError("password=do-not-log")

    service = MonitoringService(BrokenFactory(), tmp_path / "state")
    caplog.set_level(logging.WARNING)
    run_id = service.start_run("question", None)
    assert isinstance(run_id, str)
    service.record_event(run_id, "dense", "succeeded", datetime.now(UTC), 1)
    service.update_preparation(run_id, make_preparation(), [])
    service.set_message_id(run_id, "message-1")
    service.finish_run(run_id, "failed", "partial", "sanitized error")

    assert service.summary(24)["total"] == 0
    assert service.list_runs(50, None, None) == []
    assert service.get_run(run_id) is None
    assert service.purge(datetime.now(UTC)) == 0
    assert "do-not-log" not in caplog.text
    assert "Traceback" not in caplog.text


```

### 块 11：test_jsonl_failure_does_not_undo_terminal_database_update（第 305—322 行）

**本块作用：**验证 JSONL 快照或清理；测试名原文为 test_jsonl_failure_does_not_undo_terminal_database_update。 本块对应源码第 305—322 行。

```python
def test_jsonl_failure_does_not_undo_terminal_database_update(
    tmp_path: Path, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
):
    state_root = tmp_path / "not-a-directory"
    state_root.write_text("file")
    service = MonitoringService(
        create_session_factory(tmp_path / "index.sqlite3"), state_root
    )
    run_id = service.start_run("question", "conversation-1")
    caplog.set_level(logging.WARNING)

    service.finish_run(run_id, "succeeded", "answer")

    assert service.get_run(run_id)["status"] == "succeeded"
    assert "Traceback" not in caplog.text
    assert "not-a-directory" not in caplog.text


```

### 块 12：test_purge_removes_only_selected_jsonl_ids（第 323—352 行）

**本块作用：**验证监控清理；测试名原文为 test_purge_removes_only_selected_jsonl_ids。 本块对应源码第 323—352 行。

```python
@pytest.mark.parametrize("naive_cutoff", [False, True])
def test_purge_removes_only_selected_jsonl_ids(tmp_path: Path, naive_cutoff: bool):
    service = make_service(tmp_path)
    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC)
    old_id = service.start_run("old", "conversation-old")
    factory = create_session_factory(tmp_path / "index.sqlite3")
    with factory.begin() as session:
        session.get(ChatRunRecord, old_id).created_at = cutoff - timedelta(days=31)
    service.finish_run(old_id, "succeeded", "old answer")

    unrelated = {
        "id": "unrelated",
        "created_at": "2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        "value": "keep",
    }
    unrelated_line = json.dumps(unrelated, separators=(",", ":"))
    malformed_line = "{not-json"
    with service.trace_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as trace:
        trace.write(unrelated_line + "\n")
        trace.write(malformed_line + "\n")

    purge_cutoff = cutoff.replace(tzinfo=None) if naive_cutoff else cutoff
    assert service.purge(purge_cutoff) == 1
    assert service.get_run(old_id) is None
    assert service.trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() == [
        unrelated_line,
        malformed_line,
    ]


```

### 块 13：test_purge_deletes_old_db_events_and_jsonl_and_is_idempotent（第 353—394 行）

**本块作用：**验证重复执行不会误删或重复追加；测试名原文为 test_purge_deletes_old_db_events_and_jsonl_and_is_idempotent。 本块对应源码第 353—394 行。

```python
def test_purge_deletes_old_db_events_and_jsonl_and_is_idempotent(tmp_path: Path):
    service = make_service(tmp_path)
    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC)
    old_id = service.start_run("old", "conversation-old")
    new_id = service.start_run("new", "conversation-new")
    factory = create_session_factory(tmp_path / "index.sqlite3")
    with factory.begin() as session:
        old = session.get(ChatRunRecord, old_id)
        old.created_at = cutoff - timedelta(days=31)
        old_event = ChatRunEventRecord(
            run_id=old_id,
            stage="prepare",
            status="succeeded",
            started_at=old.created_at,
            ended_at=old.created_at,
            duration_ms=0,
            details_json={},
        )
        session.add(old_event)
    service.finish_run(old_id, "succeeded", "old answer")
    service.finish_run(new_id, "succeeded", "new answer")

    assert service.purge(cutoff) == 1
    assert service.get_run(old_id) is None
    assert service.get_run(new_id) is not None
    with factory() as session:
        assert (
            session.scalars(
                select(ChatRunEventRecord).where(ChatRunEventRecord.run_id == old_id)
            ).all()
            == []
        )
    trace_path = tmp_path / "state" / "monitoring" / "chat-trace.jsonl"
    remaining = [json.loads(line) for line in trace_path.read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [snapshot["id"] for snapshot in remaining] == [new_id]

    assert service.purge(cutoff) == 0
    assert [
        json.loads(line) for line in trace_path.read_text().splitlines()
    ] == remaining


```

### 块 14：test_jsonl_purge_failure_preserves_db_ids_for_successful_retry（第 395—435 行）

**本块作用：**验证监控清理；测试名原文为 test_jsonl_purge_failure_preserves_db_ids_for_successful_retry。 本块对应源码第 395—435 行。

```python
def test_jsonl_purge_failure_preserves_db_ids_for_successful_retry(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
):
    service = make_service(tmp_path)
    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC)
    old_id = service.start_run("old", "conversation-old")
    new_id = service.start_run("new", "conversation-new")
    factory = create_session_factory(tmp_path / "index.sqlite3")
    with factory.begin() as session:
        session.get(ChatRunRecord, old_id).created_at = cutoff - timedelta(days=31)
    service.finish_run(old_id, "succeeded", "old answer")
    service.finish_run(new_id, "succeeded", "new answer")
    unrelated_line = json.dumps({"id": "unrelated", "value": "keep"})
    malformed_line = "{not-json"
    with service.trace_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as trace:
        trace.write(unrelated_line + "\n" + malformed_line + "\n")
    original_lines = service.trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    original_purge_jsonl = service._purge_jsonl
    should_fail = True

    def fail_once(run_ids: set[str]) -> None:
        nonlocal should_fail
        if should_fail:
            should_fail = False
            raise OSError("temporary JSONL failure")
        original_purge_jsonl(run_ids)

    monkeypatch.setattr(service, "_purge_jsonl", fail_once)

    # The legacy instrumentation wrapper stays fail-open and leaves DB IDs intact.
    service.purge(cutoff)
    assert service.get_run(old_id) is not None
    assert service.get_run(new_id) is not None
    assert service.trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() == original_lines

    assert service.purge(cutoff) == 1
    assert service.get_run(old_id) is None
    assert service.get_run(new_id) is not None
    remaining_lines = service.trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    assert json.loads(remaining_lines[0])["id"] == new_id
    assert remaining_lines[1:] == [unrelated_line, malformed_line]
```
